plan: [This is a second-price sealed-bid (Vickrey) auction with independent private values. Truthful bidding is a dominant strategy for a risk-neutral bidder: bid your private value to maximize expected payoff regardless of others' strategies. Others are rational and know this, but that doesn't change optimality. Bid $22 (allowed in $0.1 increments). Ties are random; rounding not needed here.]

[Truthful bidding (bid my private value $15) is a dominant strategy in a Vickrey auction with independent private values. Other bidders are rational and likely to bid their values. Bidding 15 maximizes expected payoff regardless of their strategies, avoids overpaying, and yields optimal long-run profit given no history.]

[Bid my true private value of $10. In a second-price sealed-bid auction, bidding your value is a weakly dominant strategy: you win exactly when value exceeds the second-highest bid and you pay that bid, so misreporting cannot increase expected payoff. No prior rounds to adjust; values are independent.]
